error[ZBX-E0204]: writing the id maps failed
  while  starting container web-1
  cause  a full id map is written by the setuid helpers, which refuse unless
         their ranges in /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid cover the ids zbx asks for
         and they are setuid root
  cause  newuidmap exited with status 1: newuidmap: write to uid_map failed:
         Operation not permitted
  helper /usr/bin/newuidmap
  name   web-1
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   run_newuidmap (3 of 52)
  fix    check the helpers and the ranges:   zbx doctor
         look at the helper:                 ls -l /usr/bin/newuidmap
  more   zbx explain E0204
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0204.html
